form.label: VPN Sessions
form.description: Aviatrix User VPN: who is connected, from where, for how long, and how much data they moved

search.query: `aviatrix_vpn` | `aviatrix_vpn_fields` | search user=$user|s$ dvc=$gateway|s$ | where "$src$"="*" OR src="$src$" | fields _time, session_id, vpn_status, user, src, dest_ip, dvc, vpn_login, vpn_logout, duration, bytes_in, bytes_out, bytes, client_platform, client_version

stats min(_time) as connected values(vpn_status) as states by session_id, dvc, dest_ip | eventstats max(connected) as newest by dvc, dest_ip | where isnull(mvfind(states, "^disconnected$")) AND connected=newest | stats count
where vpn_status="disconnected" | stats sum(bytes) as bytes | eval bytes=`aviatrix_bytes_format(coalesce(bytes, 0))`
where vpn_status="disconnected" | stats avg(duration) as d | eval d=`aviatrix_duration_format(round(coalesce(d, 0)))`

panel.title: Open Sessions
panel.description: Connected in the time range with no disconnect logged, and the virtual IP not since reassigned to a newer session

search.query: stats min(_time) as connected values(vpn_status) as states latest(src) as src latest(client_platform) as platform latest(client_version) as client by session_id, user, dvc, dest_ip | eventstats max(connected) as newest by dvc, dest_ip | where isnull(mvfind(states, "^disconnected$")) AND connected=newest | eval connected_for=tostring(now()-connected, "duration"), connected=strftime(connected, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - connected | table connected, connected_for, user, dvc, dest_ip, src, platform, client | rename dvc as gateway, dest_ip as virtual_ip, src as "client public IP"

panel.title: Sessions Started Over Time by Gateway

search.query: where vpn_status="active" | timechart count by dvc
where vpn_status="disconnected" | timechart sum(eval(round(bytes_in/1048576, 2))) as "from clients" sum(eval(round(bytes_out/1048576, 2))) as "to clients"

stats dc(eval(if(vpn_status="active", session_id, null()))) as sessions sum(duration) as seconds sum(bytes_in) as bytes_in sum(bytes_out) as bytes_out dc(src) as public_ips latest(_time) as last_seen by user | sort - seconds | eval connected_time=if(isnull(seconds), "-", tostring(seconds, "duration")), from_clients=if(isnull(bytes_in), "-", `aviatrix_bytes_format(bytes_in)`), to_clients=if(isnull(bytes_out), "-", `aviatrix_bytes_format(bytes_out)`), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table user, sessions, connected_time, from_clients, to_clients, public_ips, last_seen
where vpn_status="active" | stats count as sessions dc(user) as users by client_platform, client_version | sort - sessions | rename client_platform as platform, client_version as "client version"
where vpn_status="active" AND isnotnull(src) | iplocation src | geostats latfield=lat longfield=lon count by user

where vpn_status="active" AND isnotnull(src) | stats count as sessions values(user) as users latest(_time) as last_seen by src | iplocation src | eval location=mvjoin(mvappend(if(City!="", City, null()), if(Region!="", Region, null()), if(Country!="", Country, null())), ", ") | eval location=coalesce(location, "private / unknown"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - sessions | table src, location, users, sessions | rename src as "client public IP"

sort - _time | eval time=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), length=if(isnotnull(duration), tostring(duration, "duration"), ""), data=if(isnotnull(bytes), `aviatrix_bytes_format(bytes)`, "") | table time, vpn_status, user, dvc, dest_ip, src, vpn_login, length, data, client_platform, client_version | rename vpn_status as status, dvc as gateway, dest_ip as virtual_ip, src as "public IP", vpn_login as "session login", client_platform as platform, client_version as client
